method_note: All eight transcripts opened from the company IR page (each with its exchange cover letter). Quotes taken via text extraction; page numbers per transcript footers, may be +/-1. Outcomes graded on the Q4 FY26 investor presentation (FY26/FY25 consolidated and segment figures) and later transcripts/filings. FY25 segment base is the presentation's restated figures. EBITDA basis is excl. other income throughout. Greenfield project moved from Jolva (Rs 250-275 cr) to Dahej-III (Rs 200 cr) between May and Jul 2026; groundbreaking timelines graded against the project, not the site. No class-10 assurance contradicted, so no override. No class-9 items: management never gave FY27-28 numbers before Q1 FY26 refused them, and Monoglyme/flame-retardant shelving is graded on the original timeline items. Q2 FY27 (Jul-Sep 2026) outcomes are not yet reported; items due in that window are left open. grade maps to engine_v3 score.
